_comment: First-principles priors for the Token Optimisation Protocol — the 'single source of estimate truth', mirroring pricing.json's role for rates. All values are order-of-magnitude engineering judgments (2026-06-25), to be overwritten per reference-class by logged actuals (hybrid calibration, PROTOCOL.md §10). Cost is NEVER stored here — only token-flow priors; dollars are always derived via pricing.py. mu0/sigma0 are in LOG space (natural log). r_out = output/input token ratio prior. ratios compose with the cheap input/scope proxy.

transform.note: output approx input; floor tight when payload inline (x1.2-1.3), x1.5-2 if only referenced

extract.note: input large, output small; output cheap

analyze.note: reasoning-heavy; output (incl. reasoning) can exceed visible answer

generate.note: output-dominated; output length weakly constrained by description

qa_lookup.note: input dominates and is usually countable; retrieval depth varies

agentic._comment: agentic r_in >> 1 due to context re-accumulation; r_in grows with breadth. mu0_r_in is ln(expected total_input / scope_proxy). N-prior gives turn count (the dominant, least-observable param). Cost dominated by p_eff * (N*H + delta*N(N-1)/2).

research.note: tool round-trips x retained context; the example task class; fattest tail

build_iterate.note: verification loops x accumulated state; code/data/ops as sub-tags

agent_loop.note: autonomy + session length + sub-agent fan-out F (each its own additive budget)

narrow_edit.note: well-specified single change; lowest-variance agentic class

_calibration_2026_06_25.comment: First hybrid-calibration pass against 793 real main-session Claude Code transcripts + 227 sub-agent sessions (backtest/). Recovered the user's effective AG-1 coefficients by OLS (actual ~ c1*N + c2*N(N-1)/2, N in 3..40, n=766, median rel.err 13%). Findings drove the H/Delta central updates above.
_calibration_2026_06_25.note_bias: First-principles H=18k/Delta=3k OVER-stated real per-turn volume by ~2.2x (geo-bias 0.46 given actual N).
_calibration_2026_06_25.note_from_description: From a description (predicting N), agentic estimates are biased LOW ~1.8x median with a ~x2.7 P10-P90 band — matches PROTOCOL §8-9. The dominant error is N (turn count); given N, volume is ~x1.4 predictable.

research_reference_class_anchor.use: Data-anchored prior for the user's example task class (read paper, research novelty, compare to SOTA).
